workItem: Harden the trusted post-merge PR production-baseline refresh against transient GitHub REST 5xx failures while preserving fail-closed behavior for semantic, authorization and boundary failures.
workItemDE: Den vertrauenswürdigen Post-Merge-Refresh der PR-Produktions-Baseline gegen transiente GitHub-REST-5xx-Fehler härten, ohne Fail-Closed-Verhalten für semantische, Autorisierungs- oder Boundary-Fehler abzuschwächen.
ownerRole: Governance CI/workflow reliability for the existing production-baseline control path; no production, deployment or foreign-project mutation authority
correlationInputs: workflow run 33471584769 failed on transient GitHub compare API HTTP 502
open PR #662 has no changed-file overlap with this claim
nonGoals: Retry semantic or authorization failures until they appear successful
Modify deployment, Render, Stripe, Supabase, IAM or production state
authorityGuard: The fix reuses the existing trusted post-merge baseline workflow and its pinned actions. Retries are bounded and limited by actions/github-script semantics so transient server failures may recover while non-retryable 4xx and repository invariant failures remain fail-closed. Human/CODEOWNER merge and separate production-mutation gates remain unchanged.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, close, supersession or abandonment. PR creation remains exact Base/Head snapshot Human/Owner-gated; merge remains Human/CODEOWNER-only.
